serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: CuraPatient, from Composite Apps, is a cloud-based payment integrity platform for healthcare claims. Its CuraClaims solution detects and investigates fraud, waste and abuse before and after payment. A claims genomics layer profiles every claim, provider and billing pattern to surface outliers and clusters of suspicious activity, and it is backed by deep models of legal, regulatory and contractual obligations that identify attempts to game the system. Working alongside support staff, CuraClaims gives review teams 10 to 50 times their capacity, with a 98.1% accuracy rate in flagging inconsistencies. CuraClaims supports the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs with secure, role-based access, full audit trails, and protection of PHI and PII. The system was assessed by First Information Technology Services (FITS), an accredited 3PAO, against the FedRAMP High baseline under NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5.
